title: Deadly Premonition 2: A Blessing in Disguise
synopsis: SWERY’s sequel and prequel, a Nintendo Switch exclusive at launch — retained as Rising Star Games’ game card.

catalog.mediumForm: Nintendo Switch game card · retail edition

custody.physical: Nintendo Switch game card in retail case

curatorNotes:
Deadly Premonition 2 is both sequel and prequel: in present-day Boston, FBI agents reopen an old case, while flashbacks return York to Le Carré, Louisiana, a town explored on foot or by skateboard. SWERY wrote and directed it.

It released exclusively on Nintendo Switch on July 10, 2020; a PC version followed in 2022.

The filing follows Origins in the Deadly Premonition lineage.
collectionNotes:
The retained object is Rising Star Games’ retail edition of Deadly Premonition 2: A Blessing in Disguise on a Nintendo Switch game card.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Nintendo Switch; compatible Nintendo Switch family hardware
preservation.compatibility: Nintendo Switch software is region-free. The retained game card is the primary access copy and runs on any Nintendo Switch console.
preservation.concerns: Game cards are flash media; long-term charge retention, contact wear, and loss of the small card from its case are the principal risks. Any content delivered as an eShop download or update depends on Nintendo’s servers and is not preserved by the card alone.
preservation.knownRevisions: Released on Nintendo Switch on July 10, 2020 (HAC-P-AVSUB); performance patches followed. A PC version released in June 2022.
preservation.availability: Distributed at retail by Rising Star Games, with a digital edition on the Nintendo eShop.
